A very rare type of spear with a head that has a cross hilt at its base, the points of which curve towards the tip. The base where the points originate is decorated with a demonic skull, resembling the one on the [[Magmas Shield]] front. The two horns of that skull form the smaller points of the spear tip. The handle of the spear is heavily ribbed. It resembles a trident.
